text: Q3. Legend says King Parameswara founded the city of X after watching a small mouse deer outwit his hunting dogs, indicating the place was auspicious. It became a premier trading hub, established the Malay language as a regional lingua franca, and served as the center for the spread of Islam in Southeast Asia. Portuguese explorer Tomé Pires stated that "Whoever is Lord of X has his hand on the throat of Venice," highlighting its total control over the spice trade between the East and Europe.
